name: GUMS
source:
In a world of crazies and lunatics, you have a simple decision to make: go home, or go to your scheduled dental appointment.

[From [url=https://maxwellhellard.itch.io/gums]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一個滿是瘋子和狂人的世界裡，你只需做一個簡單的決定：回家，還是照約定去看牙醫。
